crossRefs.note: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome and powerful, and exceedingly…
The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that…
Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

translations.web: “Thus he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down, and break it in pieces.
translations.bsb: This is what he said: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on the earth, different from all the other kingdoms, and it will devour the whole earth, trample it down, and crush it.
translations.kjv: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
translations.asv: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
